title: modbus-studio: simulator
description: Values exported by modbus-studio to InfluxDB from the bundled simulator.

list.name: window
list.label: Window
list.description: The measurement: the polling window's name.

list.name: alias
list.label: Alias
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "${bucket}", tag: "alias",
  predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "${window}", start: -1d)

panels.title: Sine wave in five encodings
panels.description: The same value as float32 in byte orders ABCD, CDAB, BADC and DCBA and as float64: the lines must overlap. One that does not means a wrong byte order.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${window}" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.alias =~ /^sine/)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "alias"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${window}" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.alias == "int32 constant" or r.alias == "uint32 constant")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "alias"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Temperature
panels.description: int16 register x10, exported with scale 0.1.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${window}" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.alias == "temperature")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "alias"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${window}" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.alias == "sawtooth")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "alias"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Selected values
panels.description: Any value of the window chosen above; pick them in the alias list.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${window}" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.alias, set: ${alias:json}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "alias"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
